decisions.Kwic: 付與山僧，曰：『向後人天眾前舉揚個事去。』

Decision.AttributionNote: 石雨禪師法檀, Shiyu Mingfang's hall address quoting his late teacher. Zhanran Yuancheng is the exact speaker of the stored command: Shiyu says his late teacher, the Yunmen master Zhanran, handed him the worn fly-whisk and told him to raise and proclaim the matter before human and celestial assemblies.

decisions.Kwic: 以拂子打圓相，曰：「會麼？會得，猶是戒相。若是戒體，須向父母未生前會取。

Decision.AttributionNote: 石雨禪師法檀, Buddha-bathing day precept-opening hall address. Shiyu Mingfang is the exact speaker: after drawing a circle with the fly-whisk, he says that understanding it is still the precept-mark and that the precept-body must be understood before one's parents were born.

decisions.Kwic: 只是改文易字，便被他換卻眼睛，至使參詢不歇。

Decision.AttributionNote: 石雨禪師法檀, opening-of-retreat informal address. Shiyu Mingfang is the exact speaker: after raising the Brahmin's letting-go case, he says later patriarchs merely changed wording and characters, by which students had their eyes exchanged and kept consulting without rest.

decisions.Kwic: 及乎到來，乃被水鳥樹林、鐘鈴鑼鼓換卻眼睛。

Decision.AttributionNote: 石雨禪師法檀, Baoshou Mountain address. Shiyu Mingfang is the exact speaker: he says that on arrival listeners have their eyes exchanged by waterbirds, groves, bells, and drums, then tests whether eye and ear can exchange their functions.
